records.section_heading: Trends in fish populations 1995-2001 – Fagatele Bay
records.question: How did overall fish abundance in Fagatele Bay change between 1995 and 2001, and how did the 2001 abundance compare to levels recorded in 1985?
records.ground_truth_answer: Overall fish abundance in Fagatele Bay showed a gradual increase from 1995 to 2001 (slight increase 1995–1998 and a more dramatic increase 1998–2001), though the reef flat did not follow this trend; however, the 2001 abundance remained lower than the levels recorded in 1985.
ground_truth_chunks: The abundance of fish in Fagatele Bay has shown a gradual increase over the last six years.
With the exception of the reef flat areas, all sites showed a slight increase in abundance from 1995 to 1998, with a more dramatic increase between 1998 and 2001.
However, the overall abundance of fish in Fagatele Bay in the 2001 surveys is still lower than levels recorded in the first survey in 1985 (Figure 3).

records.section_heading: Coral and Fish Communities around Tutuila Island
records.question: Which Tutuila sites does the section recommend should continue to be monitored despite discontinuing other local surveys?
records.ground_truth_answer: Exceptions include the sites in Pago Pago Harbour (Rainmaker and Aua), and continued long-term fish monitoring at three sites: Fagatele Bay, Sita Bay, and Cape Larsen.
ground_truth_chunks: Therefore, we recommend that these surveys be discontinued in future, especially since archipelago-wide surveys, which commenced in the mid 1990s (Green 1996, Mundy 1996, Fisk & Birkeland 2002, Green et al 2002), provide much more comprehensive data. Exceptions should include the sites in Pago Pago Harbour (Rainmaker and Aua), which should continue to be monitored because of their value for long term monitoring and management of the harbour.

The long term monitoring of fishes at three sites around the island (Fagatele Bay, Sita Bay, Cape Larsen) should also continue, because it is the oldest quantitative fish data for the island, and the only data set that predates the Crown-of-Thorns starfish outbreak in the late 1970s.
